rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.notes: Bright, sleek kitchen: white handleless cabinets, black stone counters and a green zellige backsplash. A 10-ft marble island seats five on stools. Stainless range under a glass chimney hood, white apron sink with a brass faucet, open honey-oak shelves.
rooms.fin: Large stone tiles; lime plaster; white handleless cabinets; black stone counters; green zellige backsplash; marble island; honey-oak open shelves; stainless range; glass chimney hood; white apron sink; brass faucet

rooms.name: Dining
rooms.notes: Seats ten under exposed fir beams and a big paper lantern. Disappearing glass to the courtyard on the south and to the pergola dining terrace on the north.
rooms.fin: Oak herringbone; lime plaster; exposed fir beams; cedar ceiling; honey-oak table; paper lantern

rooms.name: Living + Conversation Pit
rooms.notes: The heart of the house, fully open to the garden: 28 ft of pocketing glass to the courtyard and a big fixed mountain-view window to the north. 16-ft sunken conversation pit with a low modular sofa, cognac leather lounge chair, paper lanterns, shoji screens to the dining room, and art on the east wall. A slim linear gas fire sits in a lime-plaster plinth (no stone fireplace).
rooms.fin: Oak herringbone; lime plaster; exposed fir beams; cedar ceiling; linen pit upholstery; cognac leather; paper lanterns; shoji screens; art wall

rooms.name: Walk-in Pantry
rooms.notes: Floor-to-ceiling open honey-oak shelving, second fridge, appliance counter.
rooms.fin: Large stone tiles; lime plaster; honey-oak open shelving

rooms.name: Mudroom + Gear
rooms.notes: Side entry from the bike racks and kitchen garden. Cubbies, boot bench, ski and helmet wall, dog wash.
rooms.fin: Large stone tiles; lime plaster; honey-oak cubbies; stone dog wash

rooms.name: Master Bedroom
rooms.notes: Floor-to-ceiling glass to the mountains with sheer linen curtains, cove lighting, and a big fan under a wood ceiling. Low linen-wrapped bed against a lime-plaster headwall ledge (no wood platform or headboard), and a pair of lounge chairs at the view window.
rooms.fin: Honey-oak floor; lime plaster; wood ceiling with cove lighting; sheer linen curtains; big ceiling fan; linen bed

rooms.name: Master Bath
rooms.notes: Deep Japanese hinoki soaking tub at the corner window under a skylight. Open walk-in rain shower behind a black-stone wall (no glass enclosure), one long floating oak vanity with integrated stone basins and matte black taps, and a WC room. Opens to a walled bath garden.
rooms.fin: Black stone floor and shower wall; lime plaster; hinoki soaking tub; floating oak vanity, integrated basins; matte black taps; skylight

rooms.name: Master Closet
rooms.notes: Walk-in closet with honey-oak millwork and a center island.
rooms.fin: Honey-oak floor and millwork; lime plaster

rooms.name: East Engawa Gallery
rooms.notes: Glazed engawa along the courtyard: honey-oak floor, sliding glass, a long low bench and wall-mounted art. Links living, bedrooms and the wellness wing.
rooms.fin: Honey-oak floor; lime plaster; black steel sliding glass

rooms.name: Laundry
rooms.notes: Next to the bedrooms. Stacked W/D pair, folding counter, drying rack.
rooms.fin: Honed limestone; lime plaster; white cabinets

rooms.name: Linen + Mechanical
rooms.notes: Linen storage, heat pump air handler, ERV, water heating.
rooms.fin: Sealed concrete; painted plaster

rooms.name: Kids' Room 1
rooms.notes: Calm white room with a window-seat reading nook on the east window, a desk by the window, low cube shelves with bins and beanbags, and a small bouldering wall with a crash mat.
rooms.fin: Honey-oak floor; calm white lime plaster; oak window seat with linen cushion; cube bins; bouldering panel

rooms.name: Jack-and-Jill Bath
rooms.notes: Shared by the kids' rooms: two vanities, WC and a tiled tub-shower in the middle room, lockable from each side.
rooms.fin: Honed limestone; white tile tub-shower; oak vanities

rooms.name: Kids' Room 2 / Guest
rooms.notes: Fits a queen bed, so it doubles as the guest room. Window-seat nook, desk by the window, cube shelves and a beanbag, and a small climbing wall feature. The Guest / Pool Bath is just across the engawa.
rooms.fin: Honey-oak floor; calm white lime plaster; oak window seat; cube bins; climbing panel

rooms.name: Guest / Pool Bath
rooms.notes: Guest-capable full bath (walk-in shower, vanity, WC) reached from the engawa, also serving the pool and Kids' Room 2 when it hosts guests.
rooms.fin: Honed limestone; tiled walk-in shower; oak vanity

rooms.name: Pool Equipment
rooms.notes: Unconditioned. Pool pump and filter, outdoor storage, exterior access only.
rooms.fin: Sealed concrete

rooms.name: South Engawa Gallery
rooms.notes: Glazed engawa that closes the courtyard ring. Lets you reach the gym and wellness rooms in winter without going outside.
rooms.fin: Honey-oak floor; lime plaster; black steel sliding glass

rooms.name: Exercise Room
rooms.notes: Calm studio look: honey-oak floor with a rubber lifting area, a high wood ceiling, and a mirror wall. Free-standing rig with wood rings and a climbing rope, Pilates Cadillac and reformer, wood water rower, treadmill, kettlebell and dumbbell rack, and a bars-and-bands wall. Glass slides open to the sprint lane and an outdoor pull-up station.
rooms.fin: Honey-oak floor; rubber lifting tiles; lime plaster; high wood ceiling; mirror wall; black steel rig; wood rings

rooms.name: Wet Room
rooms.notes: Black-stone wet room: two rain showers, a built-in cold plunge lined in green zellige (39-50 F), teak bench. Serves the sauna and steam room.
rooms.fin: Black stone floor and walls; green zellige plunge; teak bench

rooms.name: Sauna
rooms.notes: Warm cedar walls with tiered pale-aspen benches, backlit underneath, and an electric rock heater (no wood stove). Low window toward the pool and meadow.
rooms.fin: Cedar walls and ceiling; pale aspen tiered benches, backlit; aspen duckboard floor; electric rock heater

rooms.name: Steam Room
rooms.notes: Stone steam room (not a white hammam): honed black stone on the walls, floor and heated bench.
rooms.fin: Honed black stone floor, walls and heated bench

rooms.name: Changing + Towels
rooms.notes: Towels, robes, honey-oak lockers. Door to the pool deck and outdoor shower.
rooms.fin: Honed limestone; lime plaster; honey-oak lockers

rooms.name: Entry Genkan
rooms.notes: Stone genkan with a step-up to the oak floor, a rammed-earth feature wall and one large artwork. Solid charred-oak pivot door (no glass entry). The first view lines up across the engawa into the courtyard.
rooms.fin: Large stone tiles; rammed-earth feature wall; lime plaster; charred-oak pivot door

rooms.name: Coat + Shoe Closet
rooms.notes: Coat and shoe storage.
rooms.fin: Honey-oak floor; oak millwork

rooms.name: Powder Room
rooms.notes: Powder room by the entry: integrated stone basin, lime-plaster walls.
rooms.fin: Honed limestone; lime plaster; integrated stone basin

rooms.name: Tatami Room
rooms.notes: 8-mat tatami room (loved) with a tokonoma alcove, low table, zabuton and a paper andon lantern. Shoji slide open to the engawa and courtyard; low garden window. Used for tea, meditation, or as an overflow guest room.
rooms.fin: Tatami; lime plaster; shoji; walnut tokonoma

rooms.name: Instrument + AV Closet
rooms.notes: Cases, cables, rack gear and the network closet. Opens to the office.
rooms.fin: Honey-oak floor; painted plaster

rooms.name: West Engawa Gallery
rooms.notes: Glazed engawa from the entry to the office and great room.
rooms.fin: Honey-oak floor; lime plaster; black steel sliding glass

rooms.name: Office / Music Loft
rooms.notes: Loft-like room with a 14-ft sculpted wood ceiling, acoustic ceiling clouds and a skylight. Sit-stand desk facing the garden glass, studio desk with the mixer, monitors and MPC, digital piano, e-drum kit, a guitar wall, mic, PA speakers, fabric acoustic panels on lime-plaster walls, layered pendants and an RGB light strip. Double-stud walls keep it acoustically separate from the bedrooms.
rooms.fin: Honey-oak floor; lime plaster; fabric acoustic panels; acoustic ceiling clouds; sculpted wood ceiling; skylight; layered pendants

furn.label: Linear gas fire in plaster plinth
Deep hinoki soaking tub by the window
Free-standing rig, wood rings + climbing rope

covered.name: Climbing Pavilion
covered.notes: Open-air timber pavilion with a standing-seam roof and 5-ft eaves, matching the house. 16-ft-wide, 12-ft-high kids' bouldering wall on the north side facing the sprint lane, over a 12-inch poured-rubber soft-fall surface. Sits in the active zone with the gym, sprint lane and a second bike rack.
